prompt: Create src/index.ts exporting `reconcile(entries: Entry[]): Report` and the types `Entry` and `Report`. An Entry is { id: string; account: string; amount: number; tag?: string }. Amounts are integers in cents and may be negative. Report is { balances: Record<string, number>; unbalancedTags: string[]; duplicateIds: string[] }. Rules, applied in this order: (1) any id appearing more than once is a duplicate; record every such id once, sorted ascending, and EXCLUDE all entries with that id from every other calculation. (2) balances sums amount per account over the remaining entries; accounts whose final balance is exactly 0 must be omitted from balances. (3) a tag is unbalanced if the sum of amounts of the remaining entries carrying that tag is not 0; list those tags sorted ascending. Entries without a tag are ignored by rule 3.
